description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Grid_Polar, which extends Image_Graph_Grid. It provides functionality for rendering a polar grid on a graph, including methods to output the grid lines as ellipses based on primary axis labels. It includes a constructor and a private method _done that performs the rendering of the grid lines.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid_Polar
classes.description: A class for rendering a polar grid on a graph, extending the Image_Graph_Grid base class.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Grid_Polar
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grid with a light grey line style.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the polar grid as concentric ellipses based on axis labels, returning true if successful.
